svg.title: Engine gate cascade as traced in triage.py
svg.desc: After the integrity check, the gene path and the two-part taxon path run independently over the same report; each gate names its threshold and the tier it assigns; both paths feed one sample verdict. Inputs and line numbers are in the table beside the figure.
